profile.headline: Junior Program Manager | Software Developer | MBA IT Management
profile.geoLocationName: Ballston Lake, New York, United States
profile.summary:
I’m currently a Junior Program Manager and Software Developer for the Naval Nuclear Propulsion Program.
I have an MBA in IT Management and a B.S. in IT Computer Science.
I have 6 years of experience in federal environments and 8 years of project management experience. 
I hold an active DOD Secret and DOE L clearance. I’m seeking a full-time role supporting technical projects with growth and development opportunities.

positions.title: Junior Program Manager | Software Developer
positions.description:
Naval Nuclear Propulsion Program | Navarro Research & Engineering

•Technical and functional consulting with key stakeholders, incorporating change-management best practices to create scalable solutions to support the Navy
•Designs, develops, implements, tests, deploys, and supports in-house computer and mobile application software, utilizing Agile methodologies and sprint planning
•Leads the development, maintenance, and support of software applications from initial design through application retirement, including improvements to enhance user experience and increase efficiency
•Full-stack Power Platform developer
•Engineer solutions and applications while navigating the full software development lifecycle and CI/CD
•Collaborate on solutions with sites across the country, sharing our solutions with other teams to support the Navy
•AI/ML agent builder
